articles.title: T-Mobile Agrees to Sell $2.0 Billion of Senior Notes
articles.mainIdea: T-Mobile Agrees to Sell $2.0 Billion of Senior Notes
articles.summary: Business Wire: T-Mobile Agrees to Sell $2.0 Billion of Senior Notes. BELLEVUE, Wash., January 07, 2026--T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) ("T-Mobile") announced today that T-Mobile USA, Inc., its direct wholly-owned subsidiary ("T-Mobile USA" or the "Issuer"), has agreed to sell $1,150,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.000% Senior Notes due 2036 (the "2036 Notes") and $850,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 5.850% Senior Notes due 2056 (the "2056 Notes," and collectively with the 2036 Notes, the "notes") in a registered public offering.
